$comment: The region of the museum's place. Read by tiles/build-tiles.sh and fetched at runtime by
the frontend under /tiles/region.json -- changes here need no new build of the frontend,
bbox is [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat] in WGS84 and serves at the same time as the
boundary beyond which the map cannot be pushed. The tiles are built with a little margin
around it, so that no grey surface turns up at the edge.
defaultZoom 14.8 shows about 5.0 x 3.0 km on a 1080p display -- roughly 1.5 km around the
village centre. Adjust it on the real display during setup; decimals are allowed.
minZoom 13 shows the whole extent at once.
streetChoice is the number of streets offered as buttons in the 'Hilf mit' panel -- the
ones nearest to 'center'. A count and not a radius, because that keeps the button budget
independent of how densely a place is built up: 80 streets fit into two questions with at
most ten buttons each. The place index may reach further; everything beyond that is tapped
This file is all a different place has to adjust. See docs/adaption.md.
